title: Computed bottom of the scl spectrum in F_2, exhaustive to length 20
body:
## What this file is

Every value of scl in [1/2, 3/4] attained by a cyclically reduced homologically
trivial word of length at most 20 in F_2 -- twenty-five values, with a shortest
witness word for each -- together with the three structured families found below
3/4, the family approaching 3/4 from above, and the sizes of the exhaustive search
at each length.

The search covered 185,502 symmetry classes, exhaustively for length at most 20,
with structured families scanned out to length 42.

The numbers here come from a computation carried out in an AI agent session in
August 2026 using `scallop`, in its rigorous exact-rational mode, and spot-checked
against two independent algorithms. **No person has checked it.** Treat it as
computational evidence and not as established fact.

## How to check it

Values were produced by `scallop` (Calegari-Walker) in `-cyclic` mode, which is an
exact rational linear program. Any individual entry can be rechecked in seconds by
running scallop on the witness word given in the table, and cross-checked with
`-mEXLP` or the independent `-local` algorithm.

The full original report and the code that produced these numbers are not published
here; they remain with the author of this record. Say so if you want them added to
the corpus as a further artifact.
